name: EJBCA Community
tagline: The open-source public key infrastructure (PKI) and certificate authority (CA)
description: The open-source public key infrastructure (PKI) and certificate authority (CA) software EJBCA is one of the longest running CA software projects. EJBCA covers all your needs - from certificate enrollment, via certificate management, to certificate validation.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-ejbca-ce application
services:
  # Service name: app
  # The `app` service definition
  big-bear-ejbca-ce:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-ejbca-ce
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: keyfactor/ejbca-ce:9.6.3@sha256:ef574ed81c1e2bb335902f1097b09f9408fe32f2c3abbccfe80999d1c9b50164
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the local ejbca-ce/persistent directory to /mnt/persistent inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/persistent:/mnt/persistent
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8080 of the host to port 8080 of the container
      - "8080:8080"
      # Mapping port 8443 of the host to port 8443 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8443"
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - TLS_SETUP_ENABLED=simple
